name: Send selection to a webhook
author: Inkstone
description: Sends the selected text (typed or recognized handwriting) with the note's title to a webhook you choose — Zapier, Make, n8n, Slack, Discord or your own server.

commands.title: Send selection to webhook
commands.keywords: zapier slack discord n8n make post share

settings.title: Webhook URL
settings.description: An https address that accepts a JSON POST.

settings.title: Format
settings.description: "json" (default) sends {title, text, noteId, page, sentAt}; "slack" sends {text} for Slack and Discord-compatible hooks.
